summary: Cardiff Oncology filed an 8-K disclosing a September 14, 2026 Confidential Settlement Agreement and Release with Nerviano Medical Sciences S.r.l., resolving litigation over inventorship of certain Cardiff patents and performance under a March 13, 2017 exclusive worldwide license to develop and commercialize onvansertib. The parties dismissed the suit with prejudice and exchanged mutual releases; neither admitted liability and no monetary payment was made. Contemporaneously, they amended the license, revising exclusivity, adding license fees, development milestones tied to Cardiff's Phase 3 program, post-termination royalty tiers, and assignment economics.
